bend_inner_radius.name: bend_inner_radius

bracket_width.name: bracket_width
bracket_width.rationale: User M5 spacing 40 mm (R06) + 2 x 1.5 x 5.5 mm edge distance = 56.5 mm minimum -> 60 mm.

leg_base_length.name: leg_base_length
leg_base_length.rationale: Last base hole row at 52 mm + 1.5 x 6.6 mm = 61.9 mm minimum -> 64 mm.

leg_upright_height.name: leg_upright_height
leg_upright_height.rationale: User hole height 35 mm (R08) + 1.5 x 5.5 mm = 43.25 mm minimum -> 50 mm.

base_hole_diameter.name: base_hole_diameter
base_hole_diameter.rationale: ISO 273 medium clearance for the user's M6 bolts.

base_hole_x0.name: base_hole_x0
base_hole_x0.rationale: Engineering decision: socket access next to the carrying leg (A06).

base_hole_pitch_x.name: base_hole_pitch_x
base_hole_pitch_x.rationale: Engineering decision: spread the four M6 bolts along the base to resist the overturning moment; plate drilled to suit (A05).

base_hole_pitch_y.name: base_hole_pitch_y
base_hole_pitch_y.rationale: Side edge distance (30 - 18) = 12 mm = 1.82 d >= 1.5 d.

upright_hole_diameter.name: upright_hole_diameter
upright_hole_diameter.rationale: ISO 273 medium clearance for the user's M5 bolts.

upright_hole_z0.name: upright_hole_z0
upright_hole_z0.rationale: User: hole centres 35 mm above the flat plate (R08 interpretation of M06).

upright_hole_pitch_z.name: upright_hole_pitch_z
upright_hole_pitch_z.rationale: Single row of holes (R06) - not used.

upright_hole_pitch_y.name: upright_hole_pitch_y
upright_hole_pitch_y.rationale: User: M5 bolts 40 mm apart horizontally.

upright_hole_rows.name: upright_hole_rows
upright_hole_rows.rationale: Two bolts side by side horizontally (R06 interpretation).

requirements.text: AI interpretation: an L-shaped bracket that holds a sensor box on a flat plate; the base leg sits on the plate and the other leg carries the sensor box.

requirements.text: AI interpretation: the supported payload is the sensor box with a mass of 2 kg (static mass only; no load direction, dynamic factor or centre of mass stated).
AI interpretation: the bracket is fastened to the flat plate with four M6 bolts.
requirements.quote: to a flat plate with four M6 bolts

requirements.text: AI interpretation: the bracket is a machined part.
AI interpretation: the bracket material is aluminium; alloy and temper are not specified.

AI interpretation: the sensor box is fastened to the carrying leg with two M5 bolts, 40 mm apart horizontally, side by side at the same height; the bracket therefore needs two M5 clearance holes in that leg.

requirements.text: AI interpretation: the sensor box centre of mass lies 40 mm from its mounting face, i.e. 40 mm away from the face of the carrying leg; this is the lever arm of the box weight.

assumptions.rationale: Tool access for the base bolts next to the carrying leg.
